passives.name: The Peculiarities of Deep Sea Squid
passives.description: (Passive Effect) When any character with Invulnerability gains a turn, their Ultimate Skill cooldown is reduced by 1 turn, regardless of whether they are an ally or enemy. Reduces all enemies’ Effectiveness by 90% and increases the caster’s Bleeding Damage Dealt by 100%. At the end of the caster’s turn, deals Fixed Damage equal to [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_458] of the target’s Max Health to enemies without any buffs. Increases damage taken from Striker enemies, and greatly reduces damage taken from attacks that target all enemies. Cursed/Fixed Damage to the Boss cannot exceed [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_336]. Deals significantly more damage when attacking fewer targets.
